title: Normalized tensor-Hom isomorphism for one finite projective module
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, φ:A→B a ring map, and F:RingSiteModules(A)→RingSiteModules(B) a functor whose objects equal the sheaf scalar extensions specified in [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map]. Let M,N be A-module sheaves on the one-object bottom-topology site. Suppose M evaluated at the unique object is a finitely generated A-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then there is an isomorphism g:F(Hom_A(M,N))→Hom_B(F(M),F(N)). For every object U, scalars b,c∈B, internal-Hom section f over U and x∈M(U), g(b⊗f) evaluated at the identity object of the slice on c⊗x is bc⊗f(x). All pure tensors use the sheafification units and F's given object equalities from [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map]. No flatness of B over A or finiteness hypothesis on N is assumed.

proof.text: Install φ.toAlgebra and the given finite/projective instances on M₀=M(*). Define t=IsBaseChange.linearMapRightBaseChangeHom B M₀ (x↦1 tensor x). After restricting scalars to A, tensor extensionality identifies t with lTensorHomEquivHomLTensor A M₀ B N₀, using the pure-tensor formula and smul_tmul'. Therefore t is bijective.

Compose LinearEquiv.ofBijective t with LinearMap.liftBaseChangeEquiv B, the scalar extension/restriction adjunction. This gives a B-linear equivalence e from B tensor_A Hom_A(M₀,N₀) to Hom_B(B tensor_A M₀,B tensor_A N₀). Simplification of the two constructions and smul_tmul' proves e(b tensor f)(c tensor x)=bc tensor f(x).

Apply the one-point-site transport theorem to e.toLinearMap and its pure-tensor formula. Its invertibility equivalence and e.bijective give IsIso g; its formula gives the required identity at every U.

theorem finiteProjectiveRingHom_extension_exists
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    (F : RingSiteModules A ⥤ RingSiteModules B)
    (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings (ringSiteMap φ) M)
    (M N : RingSiteModules A)
    (hp : Module.Projective A (M.val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩)))
    (hf : Module.Finite A (M.val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩))) :
    ∃ g : F.obj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) M N) ⟶
        SheafOfModules.homObj (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf B) (F.obj M) (F.obj N),
      IsIso g ∧ ∀ (U : (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1})ᵒᵖ) (b c : B)
        (f : (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) M N).val.obj U)
        (x : M.val.obj U),
        ((g.val.app U (ringExtensionPure φ F hF _ U b f)).app
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U.unop)))) (ringExtensionPure φ F hF M U c x) =
        ringExtensionPure φ F hF N U (b * c) ((f.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U.unop)))) x)
